text: こんどこそ　ウサ　ばらし　させろ！

structure.jp: ウサ　ばらし　させろ！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる is the 'let someone do' form of する, and here it is in its rough order form させろ. ウサ　ばらし　させろ = 'let me blow off steam'.

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ puts strong stress on the word before it, like 'this one and no other'. こんどこそ = 'this time for sure'.
